BioNatIn B.V..evidence: The company's official website outlines its active operations and certifications through 2026. It manufactures and supplies lactoferrin ingredients derived from dairy streams for use in dietary supplements and food products.

Glanbia Ingredients Ireland.evidence: Glanbia Ingredients Ireland (later Glanbia Ireland) was renamed to Tirlán in 2022 following a co-op buyout, and its parental brand Glanbia plc supplies lactoferrin ingredients under the Bioferrin brand according to corporate history and news sources.
